---
title: "Blog"
page-layout: full
include-before-body: ../assets/html/particles-embed.html
include-after-body: ../assets/html/particles-scripts.html
listing:
  # Only English posts, plus Portuguese ones with no English version yet — see
  # `en-version` in ../CONTEXT.md.
  #
  # This page has a Portuguese twin (index-pt.qmd) rather than two when-profile
  # blocks like ../index.qmd, because two listings on one page share a single
  # category filter widget whose counts then aggregate across both — the hidden
  # listing's posts get counted. One listing per page is the only way to keep the
  # category counts honest. Each profile's `render:` list excludes the other file.
  id: blog-listing
  contents: "[0-9]*.qmd"
  exclude:
    en-version: true
  type: grid
  categories: true
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [title, description, categories, date]
toc: false
---
